question: E8, the rules played by scripts: how much of what the five rule sets earn is already in the rules, and how much is in the model that carries them out? Each rule set is played by a program (src/agent_coordination/scripted.py) that sees what an agent in its seat sees and follows the rule, with fixed conventions where the rule leaves a choice open. Arm A: script against script, the 25 ordered pairs of rules, no model call, compared with the same 25 cells of E1-R played by the model. Arm C: each script against the default agent (the model, as in E1-R) in either seat, compared with E1-R's default pair and with E1-R's model-given-the-rule on the same instances. Arm B: one variant of each script, changing the convention that looked most open, against the five scripts and against the default agent.
